integrity: The family is checked directly against all associative-trialgebra identities. Explicit invertible basis changes prove the parameter collapse, product-image dimensions separate the strata, and derivation and centroid spaces are independently reconstructed from their defining linear equations.
scientific_limitations: The result normalizes only the displayed T_2^8(a,b) family and does not reclassify every parameterized family in the source.
The source's phrase pairwise non-isomorphic may have been intended only across its eight labels, but its later single derivation and centroid rows still fail to cover both nonzero T_2^8 strata.
title: The \(T_2^8(a,b)\) trialgebra family has three isomorphism strata
